notes: v474 — a full security review, and the fixes for it. The biggest one: our server used to accept the indicator numbers from your browser and answer which signals fired, which meant anyone could ask it "does it fire at 49? at 51?" and work out every threshold in about three requests. It now takes the price history and works the indicators out itself. Also: your API key is no longer sent through free public relays; the ASX announcements token has left the published file; a security policy now limits what any injected script could do; the report window is properly sandboxed; and a setting that could have repointed the whole app at somebody else's server is gone. Today's signals now arrive together with the year's grades, so the app makes one request per load instead of two. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
